headline: International Gemological Institute submits SEBI compliance certificate
hook: Routine regulatory filing by the gemological institute
summary: International Gemological Institute Limited has submitted its compliance certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018 to the stock exchange. This is a routine regulatory filing confirming compliance with depository procedures. No financial numbers or business updates were disclosed in the filing. For an Indian retail investor, this procedural update has no direct impact on stock valuation or financial performance.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no impact on share price.
